offering_description.value: ACM Research designs and manufactures wafer cleaning, electroplating, thermal processing, and other equipment for semiconductor fabrication and advanced packaging. It sells directly to chipmakers and packaging companies and provides field service and spare parts.

primary_products.value: wafer cleaning systems; electroplating systems; thermal processing furnaces; coat-and-develop tracks; advanced packaging wet-process tools

customer_segment.value: B2B: Semiconductor foundries, memory chipmakers, integrated device manufacturers, and outsourced assembly and test companies

end_markets.value: logic and foundry manufacturing; memory chip manufacturing; advanced semiconductor packaging

revenue_model.value: product sales: Semiconductor processing equipment and replacement parts; service fees: Equipment maintenance and repair

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds wafer processing systems from sourced components for chipmakers and packaging companies

geography_served.value: global: Mainland China is its primary market, with operations or customers elsewhere in East Asia and the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Wafer cleaning, electroplating, thermal processing, coating and developing, and advanced packaging equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: In-house sales and applications teams serving chipmakers and packaging companies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security export controls apply to certain semiconductor equipment, technology, and customers
